drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find our revised draft proposing a Settlement Amount of USD 40,000,000, payable by July 31, 2026. We have also clarified the release and added customary confidentiality exceptions. We welcome your comments.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 40,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff no later than July 31, 2026.
edits.name: Payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full, Plaintiff releases Defendant and its officers, directors, employees, agents, successors, and assigns from all claims, known or unknown, arising out of the matters alleged in the dispute between Plaintiff and Defendant through the date of this Agreement. This release does not affect either party’s rights or obligations under this Agreement.
edits.name: Release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal and tax advisers; disclosures reasonably necessary for tax reporting, accounting, or enforcement of this Agreement; and disclosures required by law, court order, or a governmental or regulatory authority. A party making a required disclosure shall, to the extent legally permitted and reasonably practicable, give the other party prompt notice.
edits.name: Confidentiality
